summary: performance lens over backend-observability (11 product path(s), a40b7a1..5867dac, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The observability wiring and contracts are largely implemented as requested, with no compatibility leftovers evident in the supplied diff. However, the default transport introduces an actionable production performance/reliability defect by emitting records on every request without handling stdout backpressure.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Respect stdout backpressure in the per-request log transport (backend/src/common/structured.logger.ts:31): The default transport writes every request and error record to `process.stdout` but discards the boolean returned by `write()` and never waits for `drain`.
